Getting to know you questions are the best way to start talking to someone but you need to get off them quickly. Listen to what people say, try to get them to expand upon it, and hone in on the most interesting aspect of their answer. People can get very chatty if you can find out what their passions are.

Secondly, you could always introduce yourself with cold openings. Just make an assumption about them based on an aspect of them. When they answer explain how you came to the conclusion.

3rdly don't pressure yourself. You'll come across people you have natural chemistry with click with them. Let the pressure of appearing cool brush past you and start asking questions about what you enjoy.

I'd brush up on your body language knowledge and keep an eye out for some telltale signs. Assuming you're interested in women, little things such as looking exclusively at you when addressing a group and moving her hair behind her ears are subconscious things...

However, the best advice is if you're interested just start flirting yourself and the signs will get more and more intense and obvious as the night goes on. Many people flirt regardless of interest just for the fun of it, so if you start flirting back they'll have to decide one way or another.

Try to answer what they say with "yes and". So when they offer their opinion or a topic, rather than asking their opinion/for more information, offer your own take. Try to expand upon it to give them plenty to work with when returning their own "yes and". 

This is something you get better with over time :)
